name: Soundtrap
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Soundtrap, record and arrange a simple multitrack song in a browser and export stems. The hard boundary is realtime collaboration, loops, instruments, education workflow, and hosted rendering, plus licensed content, rights, and distribution network.
